title: chat composer: extension accept tokens (.pdf, .csv, .xlsx…) never match, so a picked CSV or PDF is silently refused
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbUb7TcZK1XUAddUmQ

Filing gate: finding from the `os-dev` of #34463 (os-dev-report comment 6996617564, class a), filed by seat 5. Probed in jsdom, not on a live app. ⛔ Not a claim. Lease `ux-2`; it starts after PR #35272 (#34463) lands, same file.

## What happens

In the console AI chat composer, `matchesAccept` (`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/elements/prompt-input.tsx`) compares each accept token with `File.type` exactly. `ChatbotEnhanced`'s default `acceptedFileTypes` are extension tokens (`.pdf,.csv,.xlsx,…`), which never equal a MIME type. A picked `.csv` or `.pdf` is refused with code `accept`, which reaches only `console.warn`; a `.png` attaches. In a mixed pick the type-failing files are dropped silently.

## Expected

The accept check follows the HTML `accept` grammar: `.ext` tokens match the file name's extension (case-insensitive), `type/*` matches the MIME prefix, exact MIME matches exactly. A file that still fails is shown to the user, not only logged (the same notice path #34463 adds for oversize files).

## Done when

A CSV and a PDF picked with the default accept list attach; a test pins extension, wildcard and exact-MIME tokens; a refused type shows the user-facing notice.

Dedupe words: composer accept extension token, matchesAccept mime, chat attachment csv pdf not attached.
